DK27.6 is a medical diagnosis code representing a chronic or unspecified gastroduodenal ulcer with hemorrhage and perforation [^src1]. Within the Danish healthcare system, this specific code plays a critical role in tracking patient safety and treatment outcomes, particularly for individuals diagnosed with [[atrieflimren|atrieflimren]] (atrial fibrillation) [^src1]. 

The code is utilized as part of a broader clinical quality indicator designed to measure the incidence of severe bleeding among atrial fibrillation patients [^src1]. Because patients with this condition are often prescribed anticoagulants, monitoring severe bleeding events is a vital component of clinical quality development coordinated by the Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram (RKKP) [^src1]. To capture a comprehensive picture of bleeding complications, DK27.6 is used alongside a wide array of other diagnostic codes. These include codes for intracranial bleeding (such as [[di60|DI60]] through [[ds066|DS066]]), other gastrointestinal bleeding codes (like [[dk25-0|DK25.0]] and [[dk29-8a|DK29.8A]]), as well as codes for urinary and respiratory tract bleeding (such as [[dj942|DJ942]] and [[dr31|DR31]]) [^src1]. 

The definitions and methodologies for these indicators, including the precise application of DK27.6, are documented in the annual reports for the Danish Atrial Fibrillation Database, serving as a technical reference for standardized data collection and regional comparison across the country [^src2].

## Claims
- For incidens af alvorlig blødning anvendes en bred vifte af diagnoser, herunder DI60–DS066 for intrakraniel blødning, DK25.0–DK29.8A og DK92.0–DK92.2 for gastrointestinal blødning samt DJ942, DN02, DR04 og DR31 for urinvejs-/lunge blødning [^src1] (di60, di61, di62, ds064, ds065, ds066, dk25-0, dk25-2, dk25-4, dk25-6, dk26-0, dk26-2, dk26-4, dk26-6, dk27-0, dk27-2, dk27-4, dk27-6, dk28-0, dk28-2, dk28-4, dk28-6, dk29-0, dk29-8a, dk92-0, dk92-1, dk92-2, dj942, dn02, dr04, dr31)
